title: If You Eat Meat You Should Know This
summary: A Kurzgesagt video on the conditions in which most farm animals are raised. It argues that cruelty is for cheaper rather than better meat, and that a small price increase per meal could avoid most of the suffering.
why: Recommended as a clear, evidence-backed introduction to the economics of animal welfare in meat and egg production.

quote.text: I highly recommend this Kurzgesagt video on how paying just a bit more for meat or eggs drastically improves animals' living conditions
